name: SlicerCache
description: Represents the current filter state for a slicer, and information about which PivotCache or WorkbookConnection object the slicer is connected to.
remarks: Use the SlicerCaches property of the Workbook object to access the SlicerCaches collection of SlicerCache objects in a workbook. Each slicer has a base SlicerCache object that represents the items displayed in the slicer and the current user interface state of the tiles displayed with their corresponding item captions. Each slicer control that the user sees in Excel is represented by a Slicer object that has a SlicerCache object associated with it.
example:
With ActiveWorkbook
 .SlicerCaches.Add("AdventureWorks", _
 "[Customer].[Customer Geography]").Slicers.Add SlicerDestination:="Sheet2", _
 Level:="[Customer].[Customer Geography].[Country]", Caption:="Country"
End With

properties.name: Application
properties.description: When used without an object qualifier, this property returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Excel application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which this object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns the parent SlicerCaches object for the specified SlicerCache object. Read-only.

properties.name: Index
properties.description: Returns the index of the specified SlicerCache object in the SlicerCaches collection. Read-only.

properties.name: OLAP
properties.description: Returns whether the slicer associated with the specified slicer cache is based on an OLAP data source. Read-only.

properties.name: SourceType
properties.description: Returns the kind of data source that the slicer is connected to. Read-only.

properties.name: WorkbookConnection
properties.description: Gets or sets the WorkbookConnection object that represents the data connection used by the specified slicer. Read/write.

properties.name: Slicers
properties.description: Returns a Slicers collection that contains the collection of Slicer objects associated with the specified SlicerCache object. Read-only.

properties.name: PivotTables
properties.description: Returns a SlicerPivotTables collection that contains information about the PivotTables that the slicer cache is currently filtering. Read-only.

properties.name: SlicerCacheLevels
properties.description: Returns the collection of SlicerCacheLevel objects that represent the levels of an OLAP hierarchy on which the specified slicer cache is based. Read-only.

properties.name: Name
properties.description: Returns or sets the name of the slicer cache.

properties.name: VisibleSlicerItems
properties.description: Returns a SlicerItems collection that contains the collection of all the visible items in the specified slicer cache. Read-only.

properties.name: VisibleSlicerItemsList
properties.description: Returns or sets the list of MDX unique names for members at all levels of the hierarchy where manual filtering is applied. Read/write.

properties.name: SlicerItems
properties.description: Returns a SlicerItems collection that contains the collection of all items in the slicer cache. Read-only.

properties.name: CrossFilterType
properties.description: Returns or sets whether a slicer is participating in cross filtering with other slicers that share the same slicer cache, and how cross filtering is displayed. Read/write.

properties.name: SortItems
properties.description: Returns or sets the sort order of the items in the slicer. Read/write XlSlicerSort.

properties.name: SourceName
properties.description: Returns the name of the data source that the slicer is connected to. Read-only.

properties.name: SortUsingCustomLists
properties.description: Returns or sets whether items in the specified slicer cache will be sorted by the custom lists. Read/write.

properties.name: ShowAllItems
properties.description: Returns or sets whether slicers connected to the specified slicer cache display items that have been deleted from the corresponding PivotCache. Read/write.

properties.name: TimelineState
properties.description: The timeline-specific state of the SlicerCache object. Read-only.

properties.name: SlicerCacheType
properties.description: Returns the type of the slicer cache: slicer (xlSlicer) or timeline (xlTimeline) . Read-only XlSlicerCacheType.

properties.name: FilterCleared
properties.description: Returns whether the slicer or timeline filter state is cleared. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: List
properties.description: True if the slicer cache is for a slicer on a table; otherwise, False. Read-only Boolean.

properties.name: RequireManualUpdate
properties.description: True when manual updates of the slicer cache are required. Read/write Boolean.

properties.name: ListObject
properties.description: Returns a ListObject object for the QueryTable object. Read-only.

methods.name: ClearManualFilter
methods.description: Clears the manual filter for the slicer cache.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified slicer cache and the slicers associated with it.

methods.name: ClearAllFilters
methods.description: Clears the filter for either slicer or timeline, depending on the slicer cache type.

methods.name: ClearDateFilter
methods.description: Clears the filter for a timeline (date filter).
